profile.headline: Software Engineer at Lockheed Martin
profile.summary: Seeking a challenging position in Software Engineering.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Aireon Space Program (2013 Harris - Program of the Year)
Checked, edited,  verified documentation for the HPL (IDS and ICD)
Created programming tools in java to parse, filter, and process data
Programmed in C on the 8051 processor
Responsible for a large portion of the softcore software and its interfaces with the FPGAs
Developed software to communicate over RMAP and SpaceWire
Worked with the intergration team with debugging both software and firmware
Modified existing Perl Script code to parse Intel Hex and its extended version

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Programmed Graphical User Interface in Java 
	Developed software around the Atmega328 Platform in C 
	Implemented time sensitive applications in micro/nano seconds
 Created a parser that parses satellite data
 Programmed in java to receive serial data from a USB port and graph it

positions.title: Embedded Microcontroller Engineer
positions.description:
Researched and tested custom design Cypress’ PSoc3 microcontroller
Incorporated microcontroller with motor drivers and relay circuits 
Implemented signal controls: Serial, Digital,  Analog , and PWM 
Familiarized with different hardware: DAC, ADC, CAN, and FPGA

positions.title: College Student - Electrical Engineering
positions.description: Electrostatic Discharge Research, UCF Collegiate Cyber Defense Club, UCF Robotics Club,
